exposure: perioperative balloon occlusion at either the anterior division of the internal iliac artery or uterine artery followed by gelfoam embolization
outcome: transfer to the intensive care unit (ICU)
cohort: 26 women with pathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean hysterectomy.
finding: The perioperative combination of balloon occlusion followed by embolization of the pelvic artery significantly reduced intraoperative estimated blood loss compared to perioperative balloon occlusion alone during cesarean hysterectomy for PAS.
followup_time: During hospitalization for postoperative outcomes; 1 and 5 minutes postpartum for Apgar scores.
